lineage.semantic_base: NHDF v0.1 normalized representation, PCKF dynamics, IHCP runtime, and closed next-generation update
lineage.early_executable_algebra: UGTS-KC 2.0 typed geometry, patterns, fields, kinematics, dynamics, topology, relations, support, and lineage
lineage.referential_layer: UGTS-KC 3.6 content-addressed acyclic typed definition graph and explicit pipelines
lineage.execution_discipline: UGTS-GN 1.1 local support, compatibility, guard, verified event, transition, and lineage

identity.definition: A finite typed state-and-operator algebra that compactly generates, transports, classifies, routes, reconstructs, and records geometric-topological state.

symbol_firewall.rule: cone slant length, linear time, and modular tick are distinct
golden ratio and phase or hinge angle are distinct
residual log magnitude and spatial log radius are distinct
jitter amplitude must be strictly below a declared guard margin
the four bit roles cannot be silently aliased
comparison ordering and packed-prefix refinement are different operators
source twist and non-orientable quotient are separate profiles
an implicit relation, exact finite SDF, and certified sampled sweep are different claim classes
circle is a base, section, or projection; sphere is a support SDF; apex is a local or distributed anchor

definition_graph.same_generation: Merkle content-addressed acyclic typed graph; child content identity binds dependency content hashes
definition_graph.instance_rule: instances bind definition content hashes; coordinates and semantic IDs are not content identity
definition_graph.pipeline_rule: pipelines bind ordered step content hashes, generation, domain, codomain, and typed adjacency
definition_graph.self_reference_rule: feedback binds endpoint content hashes, named typed ports, and enters exactly generation n+1 through an explicit edge
definition_graph.unproven_claim: an unrestricted fixed point or same-generation authority cycle is not implemented

canonical_chain.role: admit only a declared local domain
check mode, sheet, orientation, type, units, and policy
evaluate a deterministic zero or interval guard
certify, conservatively classify, or return INDETERMINATE
apply one bounded declared branch and atomic transition
append the previous lineage digest and canonical event-payload novelty digest; state hashes are explicit payload fields when present
retain exogenous or non-regenerable change under an explicit budget

typed.rule: all operators and relations are typed before execution

vector.rule: arrows are compact origin-plus-vector primitives; projections do not become identity

kinematic.rule: motion is causal and time never becomes a wrapped phase

geometry.rule: exact SDF, implicit field, and certified bound are labelled separately

topology.rule: Klein and Mobius motifs are explicit quotient or routing maps, never material magic

packing.rule: a key or bit is not semantically equivalent to omitted state without reconstruction evidence

predicate.rule: there is no fuzzy truth; uncertainty is an interval or explicit refusal to classify

operator.rule: composition uses an explicit typed DAG and bounded pipeline

self_reference.rule: generated output may propose the next state or an extension but cannot rewrite its own authority

source_records.authority: provenance only; unsupported performance and stability claims excluded

determinism.discrete_state: fixed-width integer, canonical JSON, SHA-256, declared ordering
determinism.geometric_numeric_backend: declared IEEE-754 binary64 reference profile or separately validated fixed-point numeric-arithmetic profile; neither implies a fixed-point iteration engine
determinism.uncertainty: bounded interval or INDETERMINATE, never fuzzy logic
determinism.randomness: forbidden unless replaced by a recorded content-addressed seed and deterministic generator
